final_answer:
Both BRCA1 and TP53 map to chromosome 17 in Homo sapiens (taxid 9606) under GRCh38; they differ in coordinate position, not chromosome.

BRCA1 (e.g., UniProt A0A087WTT3, "BRCA1 DNA repair associated") — the EBI Proteins API record lists gnCoordinate genomicLocation exons spanning roughly chr17:43,049,121–43,124,096 (consistent with the canonical chr17:43,044,295–43,125,364 GRCh38 span). Querying with chromosome=17&gene=BRCA1&taxid=9606 returned the same records, confirming chr17 assignment.

TP53 (e.g., A0A087WT22, "Cellular tumor antigen p53", Ensembl ENSG00000141510/ENST00000610623) — record explicitly reports chromosome "17", start 7,675,134, end 7,673,222, reverseStrand true, nucleotideId CM000679.2, assemblyName GRCh38, i.e. chr17:~7.67 Mb (canonical TP53 GRCh38 span chr17:7,668,402–7,687,550).

Distribution summary: both tumor-suppressor genes are on chr17 but at opposite ends of the chromosome — TP53 in 17p13.1 (~7.7 Mb, minus strand) and BRCA1 in 17q21.31 (~43.1 Mb).

JSON access / validation: the same tool wraps the EBI Proteins API coordinates endpoint, so JSON is obtained by setting format=json, e.g. https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/coordinates?offset=0&size=10&gene=BRCA1&taxid=9606 and https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/coordinates?offset=0&size=5&gene=TP53&taxid=9606 (add chromosome=17 to filter). Tool parameters used: search_genomic_coordinates(gene="BRCA1"/"TP53", taxid=9606, format="json"). The returned JSON contains accession, gene, per-exon genomicLocation (begin/end), chromosome, start/end, reverseStrand, nucleotideId, assemblyName, plus Ensembl gene/transcript/translation IDs — enough to cross-check against Ensembl/RefSeq/UCSC. Note the records returned are per-isoform entries (e.g., a 27-aa BRCA1 fragment, a 393-aa p53), so for full-gene coordinates validate against the canonical entries/assemblies named above rather than only the first hit.
